neutral_a: The library opens each morning. Books stand on wooden shelves near the windows. Visitors read quietly at the tables. A garden lies behind the building, with a path leading to the entrance. Staff arrange the returned books and keep the reading rooms tidy.
neutral_b: A traveler walked through a town beside a river. The streets passed between brick houses and small shops. Trees shaded the square, and birds rested near the fountain. In the evening the lights came on and people returned home.
